title: Final Distance Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the distance x traveled as a function of v and g.

title: Use of Lorentz Transformations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Lorentz transformations to relate velocities and accelerations in different frames.

title: Acceleration Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the transformation of acceleration correctly using the given definitions.

title: Integration Process
description: Important Criteria: The student should show the correct integration steps leading to the final expression for distance.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes when applying transformations or during integration.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no factors are omitted in the final expression for distance.
